ext_description: Redact sensitive data locally before you paste it into AI chats.
engine_regex_desc: Pattern matching for credentials, connection strings and PII (phone / ID / bank card) · base engine, always on
engine_ai_desc: Unstructured entities such as names and addresses, plus scene detection (downloads a ~180 MB model, one time only)
engine_load_failed: Model failed to load; base detection is unaffected
ner_downloading_other: Downloading in another window, waiting to sync…
ner_first_download: First run downloads the model (~180 MB, quantized). Please wait.
onboarding_body: AI enhancement recognises names, addresses and other unstructured content for fuller coverage. Enabling it downloads a ~180 MB quantized model (one time only; processed locally, nothing is uploaded). Pattern-based detection (keys, phone numbers, ID cards…) works fine without it.
input_placeholder: Paste or type text containing sensitive data…
results_empty_desc: No sensitive data found — safe to send
profile_universal_desc: Union of all rules with arbitration: credentials replaced outright, medium/low confidence only flagged
profile_text_desc: PII-focused with tighter entropy — good for chat, docs and tickets
profile_code_desc: All credential rules on, looser entropy, PII only flagged — good for config and code
profile_us_desc: Adds US SSN / EIN / phone number with region-specific validation
profile_eu_desc: Adds IBAN and VAT numbers with checksum validation
paste_section_desc: Auto-redact on paste in sites you authorise (pattern rules only, no model needed). Unauthorised sites are untouched.
paste_empty: No sites added — paste behaviour is unchanged
paste_err_invalid: Unrecognised site — enter a domain or an https URL
paste_err_exists: That site is already in the list
paste_ok_added: Added. Already-open pages take effect immediately; pasting is now auto-redacted.
ps_description_placeholder: One line on when to use this profile
ps_tier_low: Only flag medium/low confidence (do not replace)
ps_whitelist_help: One per line; exact matches are skipped
ps_rule_redos_hint: Nested quantifiers (e.g. (a+)+) are rejected to prevent ReDoS; each pattern gets a 50 ms budget
ps_export_title: Copy all custom profiles to the clipboard as JSON
ps_err_no_export: No custom profiles to export (built-ins need no export)
ps_ok_exported: All custom profiles copied to the clipboard as JSON
ps_err_read_failed: Couldn't read the clipboard; paste it manually
ps_err_empty_clipboard: Clipboard is empty — copy the profile JSON first
